processes.note: a profile's `processes.running` names what must be up; this says how to put it there. The script starts only what is NOT already running and stops on restore only what it started - a process the owner already had up is never touched at either end. `stop_task` is a Scheduled Task the owner registers once, with RunLevel Highest, that stops these by name: RTSS's manifest is requireAdministrator, so an unelevated shell can start it but cannot stop it. Without the task a run that started one says so and keeps saying so until it is gone.

presentmon.note: the binary every present measurement in this project was taken with; a different one is named in the run manifest, not refused
